groups.rationale: Overalls-only top-level files (README, SECURITY, licence, GitHub templates, Claude settings) and the OSS Scanner qualification Dockerfile and threat model; no documented behavior, configuration, protocol or deployment change.

Current route projection now selects the gateway's fleet-certificate installation for the configured zone, matching report_ready and delivery; documented known-hosts behavior (current route key only, refusal otherwise) is unchanged and routes_test covers a second zone at the same generation.
Only 04-lifecycle gained the Lilly native readiness-budget rule; GuestAgents.readiness_budget_ms and the protocol capability table are unchanged.
Moved the awaiting-trust-preserves-agent-budget contract above the existing prose comment in provisioning.ex; behavior and the 04-lifecycle readiness-budget text recorded earlier are unchanged.

lyra's overalls-host-certificate asks Marshall on every gateway run instead of trusting a still-valid certificate's stored principal (gateway-principal-from-authority); chapter 12 documents the daily reissue after a management-host change.

Host declarations, the host tool, remote preflight and enrollment now poll and check trunk of ssh://git@github.com/ghuntley/overalls instead of main of antithesishq/kittens; 13-deployment names the update source and branch. SSH transport, shared deploy key and pinned GitHub host key are unchanged; fixtures follow the new repository and branch.

ADR-0043 correction and the host-provisioning guide now name ghuntley/overalls trunk as the update source; the governance chapters (reference, coverage, security, domains, topology) describe no update repository or branch, and 13-deployment carries the reader-visible statement.
